entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I need to... I think I need to return something. My VeloBand Pulse monitor.
I can certainly look into that for you. To understand better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, I don't think it's broken or anything. It's just... it's really hard to use. I've been trying to figure it out since I got it, but all the menus and settings are so confusing.
I see. I'm sorry to hear it's not as intuitive as you'd hoped.
Yes, I just... I really expected more, you know? The website made it look so simple. I feel a bit overwhelmed by it all. Can't you just help me? I'd rather just send it back.
I understand your frustration. Just to cover all our bases, have you had a chance to go through the user manual? It has some step-by-step guides that can be quite helpful.
The user manual? I think I saw it in the box, but it looked so technical. I just wanted something that works easily. I don't want to have to study for it. I just want my money back.
Okay, not a problem at all. Let me just pull up your order details and review the policy for you. One moment please.
Alright, I see your order here. It looks like the VeloBand Pulse was delivered to you 31 days ago. And according to our policy, you are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window.
Oh, really? So it's not too late? I can still return it?

Yes, absolutely. I can go ahead and start that return process for you right now. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. You just need to print it out, place the band back in its original packaging, and drop it off at the post office.
That's wonderful! Thank you so much, Diana. That's such a relief.
You're very welcome. Once our warehouse receives the item, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help. Thank you!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
